en: Black‑and‑white view of a broad tree‑lined urban avenue flanked by several‑storey townhouses with ornate façades and mansard roofs. On the right, tall residential buildings with wrought‑iron balconies and fenced front gardens form a continuous block; pedestrians in early‑20th‑century clothing and a few children walk along the sidewalk. The left side shows more modest buildings and bare winter trees along a wide, mostly empty carriageway where a horse‑drawn vehicle is visible in the distance. The sky area is blank and unprinted, giving the image a vignetted look typical of old postcards. No legible text appears in the picture area.
